reason: I already take my Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Two capsules every day is also more than I want to deal with.
objection: I already have a supplement I trust and take. Two capsules a day is a chore, and a new brand with a first batch of 1,000 boxes has no track record for me.
would_change_my_mind: A single capsule per sachet at the same price, or a free trial box I could try next to my current one on a work trip.
